Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1163
Claimant:
Katherine Cline
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
November 8, 2024
Claim opened for a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving the insured's vehicle and a second vehicle. The
claimant reports a head injury diagnosed as a concussion and says they are not represented by an attorney.
December 19, 2024
Reviewed the policy file and confirmed the driver of the insured vehicle is named on the policy and coverage was in
force at the time of loss.
January 2, 2025
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of the collision. Witness
statements on file describe the accident the same way the claimant did.
January 21, 2025
Photos from the scene and the other driver's statement both confirm the collision happened as described. The
damgae visible on the vehicle matches the impact reported.
February 3, 2025
Spoke with the claimant by phone. They gave the same account of the collision that was recorded at intake, with no
changes in the sequence of events.
March 24, 2025
Inspected the vehicle and found no earlier damage in the affected areas. Nothing in the file suggests any damage
predates the start of coverage.
March 26, 2025
Asked the claimant about any prior head or neck injuries. No earlier injury to the same body area is known from the
information provided so far.
April 6, 2025
Medical records show treatment for the concussion followed a uusal course, with visits tapering off as the claimant
improved. Whether the injury came from this crash has not yet been established and will need further medical review.
April 10, 2025
Second call with the claimant to check on symptoms and recovery. They repeated the same account of the accident
and said they are feeling better.
May 26, 2025
Requested updated treatment notes and a physician's statement to clarify the link between the collision and the
diagnosis. Awaiting response.
May 28, 2025
Reviewed the full file. Liability and vehicle damage are consistent with the reported loss. The bodily injury portion
stays open pending the medical review.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
